learning.learning_goal: Hear, see, and connect each number from 1 through 10 to a group of objects.
learning.big_idea: A number can name how many objects are in a group.
novice_success_criteria: say or identify the number words from one through ten
connect each numeral from 1 through 10 to its spoken name and quantity
count a group to ten by counting each object once

screens.label: Start here
screens.title: Meet the numbers 1 through 10.
screens.body: Tap Listen whenever you want the screen read aloud.
screens.audio: We will learn the numbers one through ten. You will see each number, hear its name, and count that many dots.

screens.label: Number 1
screens.title: 1 — one
screens.audio: This is one. One dot. Tap the dot to hear one.

screens.label: Number 2
screens.title: 2 — two
screens.audio: This is two. Two dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two.

screens.label: Number 3
screens.title: 3 — three
screens.audio: This is three. Three dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three.

screens.title: Count the dots.
screens.audio: Count the blue dots. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots in a row.

choices.feedback: Look at the dot on the right, too.
Check that you did not count a dot twice.

hints: Start with the dot on the left. Count each dot once.

screens.label: New word
screens.title: This is a group.
screens.audio: These three dots are together inside one box. Dots together are called a group. This is one group of three dots.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots together inside one box.
visual.message: Dots together in one box are a group.

screens.label: Number 4
screens.title: 4 — four
screens.audio: This is four. Four dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three, four.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Four blue dots together in one box.

choices.feedback: Look at every dot, including the one on the right.
There are four dots in this group.
Count each dot once. Check that none was counted twice.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four.

screens.label: Number 5
screens.title: 5 — five
screens.audio: This is five. Five dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three, four, five.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look at the dot on the right. Count it too.
Check that you counted each dot only once.
There are five dots in this group.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four, five.

screens.label: Number 6
screens.title: 6 — six
screens.audio: This is six. Six dots. Tap the dots in order from one through six.

screens.label: Number 7
screens.title: 7 — seven
screens.audio: This is seven. Seven dots. Tap the dots in order from one through seven.

screens.label: Number 8
screens.title: 8 — eight
screens.audio: This is eight. Eight dots. Tap the dots in order from one through eight.

screens.label: Number 9
screens.title: 9 — nine
screens.audio: This is nine. Nine dots. Tap the dots in order from one through nine.

screens.label: Number 10
screens.title: 10 — ten
screens.audio: This is ten. Ten dots. Tap the dots in order from one through ten.

screens.title: The total is the whole group.
screens.body: The last number is the total. Total means the number of dots in the group.
screens.audio: Count each dot once. The last number is the total. Total means the number of dots in the whole group.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Ten blue dots together inside one box.

choices.feedback: You may have missed a dot. Start on the left and count again.
There are ten dots in this group.
You may have counted a dot twice.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count slowly from one through ten.

screens.title: What is the total?
screens.prompt: You count four dots. What is the total?
screens.audio: You count four dots. What is the total? Choose an answer.

choices.feedback: Yes. The total is four dots.

hints: Total means the number of dots in the whole group.

screens.title: Count a new group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in this new group. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Six blue dots together inside one box.

choices.feedback: Check that you counted each dot only once.
Look for a dot you may have missed.
There are six dots in this group.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again from one through six.

screens.title: What is a group?
screens.prompt: The dots are together inside one box. What do we call them?
screens.audio: The dots are together inside one box. What do we call them? Choose an answer.
hints: Think about all the dots together.
Dots together are called a group.

screens.title: You met the numbers 1 through 10.
screens.body: Next, learn what a pair is.
screens.audio: You finished. You saw, heard, and counted the numbers one through ten. Next, you can learn what a pair is.
